build_semantic_map_from_trajectory: build a 2D semantic map from a robot trajectory by running the click CLI with input trajectory pickle files
run_semantic_map_visualization: run the offline mapping script to generate visualization images and a video from robot observation trajectory files
create_semantic_map_vis: create a visualization image combining semantic segmentation, depth, and predicted semantic map using get_semantic_map_vis
create_video_from_images: create an mp4 video from a list of numpy image arrays using the create_video function with a specified fps
preprocess_robot_observations: preprocess home robot observations into tensors with RGB, depth, semantic, and instance channels for map building
